cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: several specific current internal practices. These are seven named ERGs (no membership figures), name pronunciation tools, heritage calendars and a Global Culture Party. Only the party reports a figure (over 1,100 employees), and it is a single internal event rather than an ongoing program with measured reach. I was torn between 2 and 3, so I chose the lower level. There is no customer-access or external community-connecting activity. Demographics (E5) are context only.

ai.notes: The 10-K gave only brief ERG language, so the sustainability report (December 2025, covering FY25) was added. ERG list is as of November 30, 2025. The Global Culture Party and other figures relate to FY25, while the 10-K covers fiscal 2026. They are treated as current per instructions, but they are not confirmed in the 10-K itself. Global Culture Celebrations (report tools list) appear to be the same activity as the Global Culture Party, so they are counted once in E2. Quotes from the report join lines across line breaks. The double space after 'Party' and after '32.1%' is kept as it appears in the source.
